title: Independent Staging backup broker authority trust discovery fails closed

phases.objective: Observe the missing independent Staging broker host trust boundary with no credential, SQL or Docker mutation, and reject spoofed operational authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Measure exact Staging host topology and dedicated Windows Broker service metadata without privileged access.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Observations report exact missing independent broker, OS, endpoint, signing and audit requirements; no authority is minted.
steps: Bind discovery to exact certified Staging release and observed host topology.
Read a dedicated Staging Broker Windows service's process identity without loading credentials or private keys.
Reject absent, stopped, privileged or unmeasured process as incomplete.
Reject forged caller supplied signed-operation, admin or audit flags.
Return fail-closed exit 2 and block real database, Backup/Restore and Production operations.
assertions: No running service or measured executable image alone grants broker, DBA, owner signature or immutable audit authority.
An inert Docker candidate cannot become an operational broker via claimed JSON attestation.
Source-head GitHub owner reviews cannot replace a separate short-lived Ed25519 DB operation ticket.
Tests and discovery remain read-only and shared connector Production mutation remains false.
